tools.name: get_nuget_packages_snippet
tools.description: Get .csproj snippet with required NuGet packages for a specific deployment scenario. Returns XML snippet ready to copy-paste into your project file.

tools.name: get_enum_values
tools.description: Get all values of a VisioForge SDK enum type with descriptions. Useful for understanding available options for configuration properties (e.g., MediaBlockType, video codecs, audio formats, pixel formats).

tools.name: list_sdk_classes
tools.description: List core VisioForge SDK classes. These are the main entry-point classes for building media applications: VideoCaptureCoreX (video capture/recording), VideoEditCoreX (video editing), MediaPlayerCoreX (media playback), MediaInfoReaderX (media analysis), SimplePlayerCoreX (simple playback), and more.

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: Browse VisioForge SDK namespaces hierarchically. Shows child namespaces and classes within a given namespace. Start with 'VisioForge.Core' or leave empty to see top-level namespaces.

tools.name: get_platform_specific_config
tools.description: Get platform-specific file copying/build configuration code. Returns MSBuild targets or post-build scripts for special deployment requirements.

tools.name: search_api
tools.description: Search across the entire VisioForge SDK API — class names, method names, property names, event names, and their documentation text. Returns ranked results. Use this when you don't know the exact class name, or to find all classes related to a concept (e.g., 'RTSP streaming', 'video overlay', 'audio

tools.name: get_media_block_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific media block including its properties, methods, events, input/output pads, constructor parameters, and documentation. Use this to understand how to configure and use a specific media block in a pipeline.

tools.name: get_pipeline_template
tools.description: Get a media block pipeline template for a specific use case. Returns the list of required blocks and how to connect them, along with C# code to build the pipeline.

tools.name: get_class_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about any VisioForge SDK class, including its full list of properties, methods, events, constructors, base class, interfaces, and documentation. Works for both core SDK classes and media blocks.

tools.name: get_method_signature
tools.description: Get the detailed signature and documentation for a specific method on a class. Useful when you need to understand a method's parameters, return type, and behavior.

tools.name: list_deployment_guides
tools.description: List available deployment guides for VisioForge SDK. Filter by platform, project type, SDK type, or scenario. Returns a list of guides with titles, summaries, and tags.

tools.name: get_code_example
tools.description: Get a code example for a common VisioForge SDK scenario. Returns complete, working C# code snippets that demonstrate how to use the SDK for tasks like video capture, RTSP streaming, media playback, and more.

tools.name: get_deployment_guide
tools.description: Get the complete deployment guide for a specific scenario. Returns detailed instructions, code snippets, NuGet packages, and platform-specific notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_platform_specific_config · Private data: get_nuget_packages_snippet, get_platform_specific_config · Public sink: get_platform_specific_config.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_platform_specific_config · Private data: get_nuget_packages_snippet, get_platform_specific_config · Public sink: get_platform_specific_config

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
